LESSON: CHILDREN’S OBLIGATIONS TO OTHER FAMILY MEMBERS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalaat
Topic 6.3: Children’s Obligations to Other Family Members

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Children’s Obligations to Other Family Members. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Children’s Obligations to Other Family Members
2. Practise Children’s Obligations to Other Family Members at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Children’s Obligations to Other Family Members

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Children’s Obligations to Other Family Members
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Children’s Obligations to Other Family Members. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Children’s Obligations to Other Family Members at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Children’s Obligations to Other Family Members at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Children’s Obligations to Other Family Members
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Children’s Obligations to Other Family Members. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Children’s Obligations to Other Family Members using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Children’s Obligations to Other Family Members in the examples.
2. Explain Children’s Obligations to Other Family Members to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Children’s Obligations to Other Family Members.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Children’s Obligations to Other Family Members using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Children’s Obligations to Other Family Members important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Children’s Obligations to Other Family Members
2. Practise Children’s Obligations to Other Family Members at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Children’s Obligations to Other Family Members

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
